items.text: **Page lists stay fast after Direct Files file lifecycle changes.** With a warm graph, creates, deletes, watcher additions/removals, and renames now update the exact in-memory page inventory instead of making the next page lookup reopen and reparse the whole graph. Rename transactions reparse only documents whose retained final bytes they already changed; explicit titles, parse failures, physical paths, and watcher invalidation remain authoritative.
